methodology.bothSources: ceil-to-5 midpoint of iCab daytime max direction and Terminal Taxi small-car fare; never lower existing fare
methodology.icabOnly: 110% of iCab daytime max; never lower existing fare
methodology.terminalOnly: 90% of Terminal small-car fare; never lower existing fare
methodology.driverGuard: for matched iCab, fare minus VanClick platform commission must be >= iCab daytime benchmark; Terminal-only net guard >= 85% of Terminal fare
methodology.timeExtras: peak +5%, Shabbat +15%, Bit +10 are applied later and are not baked into these base fares
